resources.string: Turn on Autostart for uMessage, and in its Battery settings allow high background power use.
Turn on Autostart for uMessage so it starts after a reboot. If the app info page opens, use its Autostart switch.
Choose No restrictions for uMessage. If a list of apps opens, tap uMessage first.
Turn on Allow auto launch and Allow background activity for uMessage. On newer phones they are in App info, Battery usage.
Choose Unrestricted, or Don\'t optimize, for uMessage. If a list opens, switch it to All apps first.
Android still limits uMessage in the background
